SQL: Queried production metadata, shooting day 12 schedule, daily progress metrics, and take-by-take details for day 12 from `slateiq.production`, `slateiq.shooting_day`, `slateiq.daily_progress`, and `slateiq.take` (joined with `slateiq.take_analysis`).
sql: SELECT title, planned_days FROM slateiq.production LIMIT 1

SELECT day_number, shoot_date, unit, call_time, actual_wrap, planned_scenes, location, weather, notes
FROM slateiq.shooting_day
WHERE day_number = 12

SELECT
    (SELECT sum(pages_shot_eighths) FROM slateiq.daily_progress WHERE day_number <= 12) AS cum_shot_eighths,
    (SELECT sum(pages_planned_eighths) FROM slateiq.daily_progress WHERE day_number <= 12) AS cum_planned_eighths,
    (SELECT sum(page_eighths) FROM slateiq.scene) AS total_script_eighths,
    pages_planned_eighths,
    pages_shot_eighths,
    setups,
    takes,
    circled,
    ng,
    wrap_delay_min
FROM slateiq.daily_progress
WHERE day_number = 12

SELECT
    count() AS total_takes,
    countIf(status = 'circled') AS circled_takes,
    sum(duration_s) AS total_duration,
    sumIf(duration_s, status = 'circled') AS circled_duration
FROM slateiq.take
WHERE day_number = 12

SELECT
    s.scene_number,
    s.slug,
    s.page_eighths,
    sp.status AS overall_status,
    countIf(t.day_number = 12) AS day_takes,
    uniqExactIf(t.shot, t.day_number = 12) AS day_setups
FROM slateiq.scene s
LEFT JOIN slateiq.scene_progress sp ON s.scene_number = sp.scene_number
LEFT JOIN slateiq.take t ON s.scene_number = t.scene_number
WHERE s.scene_number IN ('6', '12', '14A', '27', '33', '39', '41', '56', '78', '91', '102')
GROUP BY s.scene_number, s.slug, s.page_eighths, sp.status
ORDER BY s.scene_number

SELECT scene_number, groupArray(distinct day_number) AS days
FROM slateiq.take
WHERE scene_number IN ('6', '12', '14A', '27', '33', '39', '41', '56', '78', '91', '102')
GROUP BY scene_number
ORDER BY scene_number

SELECT scene_number, takes, circled, setups, first_day, last_day, print_ratio, status
FROM slateiq.scene_progress
WHERE scene_number IN ('6', '12', '14A', '27', '33', '39', '41', '56', '78', '91', '102')
ORDER BY scene_number

SELECT DISTINCT scene_number
FROM slateiq.take
WHERE day_number = 12 AND scene_number NOT IN ('6', '12', '14A', '27', '33', '39', '41', '56', '78', '91', '102')

SELECT status, count()
FROM slateiq.take
WHERE day_number = 12
GROUP BY status

SELECT count() FROM (
    SELECT scene_number, shot, take_number
    FROM slateiq.take
    WHERE day_number = 12 AND status IN ('circled', 'hold')
    GROUP BY scene_number, shot, take_number
)

SELECT
    t.scene_number,
    t.shot,
    t.take_number,
    groupArray(t.camera) AS cameras,
    any(t.tc_in) AS tc_in,
    any(t.duration_s) AS duration,
    any(t.status) AS status,
    any(t.director_note) AS director_note,
    any(ta.performance_note) AS performance_note
FROM slateiq.take t
LEFT JOIN slateiq.take_analysis ta USING (take_id)
WHERE t.day_number = 12
GROUP BY t.scene_number, t.shot, t.take_number
ORDER BY t.scene_number, t.shot, t.take_number
LIMIT 200

SELECT
    t.scene_number,
    t.shot,
    t.take_number,
    arrayStringConcat(groupArray(t.camera), '/') AS cameras,
    any(t.tc_in) AS tc_in,
    any(t.duration_s) AS duration,
    any(t.status) AS status,
    any(t.director_note) AS director_note,
    any(ta.performance_note) AS performance_note
FROM slateiq.take t
LEFT JOIN slateiq.take_analysis ta USING (take_id)
WHERE t.day_number = 12 AND t.status IN ('circled', 'hold')
GROUP BY t.scene_number, t.shot, t.take_number
ORDER BY t.scene_number, t.shot, t.take_number
LIMIT 100

SELECT scene_number, count() AS other_takes
FROM slateiq.take
WHERE day_number = 12 AND status NOT IN ('circled', 'hold')
GROUP BY scene_number
ORDER BY scene_number
